description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying {2}{G}.
When Scurry Oak enters the battlefield, Black Panther triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak, as it is a Forest land due to Ashaya.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Black Panther triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak, as it is a Forest land due to Ashaya.
Repeat from step 3.
